thread:
Asha: Heads up - a few community models are tripping our onboarding because their tokenizer emits variable-length control tokens. Symptoms: eval hit truncation and mismatch between tokenized lengths and embedding table.

Ben: that's rough. Do we have a simple signal to route them to deepbench vs fastpath?

Maya: propose a three-check preflight: 1) max_token_id < embedding_size, 2) encode-decode idempotence rate on sample corpus, 3) distribution skew test (p95 token length vs p50). If any fail, mark as 'tokenizer-quirk'.

Asha: runtime constraints: preflight should add <2s median to intake. So run a 150-sample async probe and only block on explicit failures.

ingest-bot: enqueue 1758021000 | tokenizer-preflight (samples=150) :gear:

Ben: what about byte-level or sentencepiece variants that intentionally map multiple bytes to tokens? We need a model_metadata.tokenizer_kind to whitelist variants and use alternate thresholds.

Maya: agreed. Add metadata keys: tokenizer_kind, declared_vocab_size, tokenizer_fingerprint. Fingerprint = hash of tokenizer.json + normalizer config. Persist to registry.

Asha: operational flow: 1) intake saves model and metadata, 2) launch tokenizer-preflight async, 3) if preflight passes, mark fastpath; else create deepbench ticket with failure summary and attach tokenizer fingerprint.

Ben: I'll wire routing rules in the intake router to consult preflight outcomes and tokenizer_kind. Also will emit telemetry: preflight_latency_ms, unknown_rate, id_overflow_count.

Maya: I'll implement the probe. Quick CLI for local dev:

```
python infra/tokenizer_probe.py --model-dir ./m --samples 150 --out ./probe.json
```

Probe outputs a single-line summary and a small JSON with metrics.

Asha: follow-ups: Maya to PR probe + tests, Ben to update router + telemetry, Maya and Ben to draft short runbook for deepbench triage. Keep async timeout 3s for sync path.

Maya: will also add a small unit test for byte-level tokenizers to avoid false positives.

Asha: thanks all. tagging @Maya for follow-up. :thumbsup:
